findings.title: No Schema.org JSON-LD structured data detected
findings.impact: Without JSON-LD, AI engines must guess your entity name, category, pricing, and official profiles from unstructured HTML.
findings.action: Paste the ready-to-deploy schema-jsonld.html snippet into your homepage <head>.

findings.title: Missing FAQPage Schema markup
findings.impact: Conversational queries in ChatGPT and Perplexity map directly to structured Question/Answer pairs.
findings.action: Add a 5–8 question FAQ section backed by the included FAQPage JSON-LD block.

findings.title: Few or no conversational question-style headings
findings.impact: AI search queries are phrased as natural questions ("How does X compare to Y?", "What does X cost?").
findings.action: Rewrite key H2/H3 headings as direct buyer questions with a 40–60 word direct answer immediately underneath.

findings.title: No explicit AI User-Agent directives in robots.txt
findings.impact: Relying only on wildcard rules leaves AI crawler permissions ambiguous when security teams or CDNs update rules.
findings.action: Add explicit Allow blocks for GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, and Google-Extended.

findings.title: No /llms-full.txt deep context file
findings.impact: Technical or B2B buyers benefit when AI assistants can read consolidated product docs in one fetch.
findings.action: Optionally publish /llms-full.txt consolidating key product specs, pricing, and FAQ answers in clean markdown.

findings.title: Limited concrete numbers or verifiable statistics in copy
findings.impact: GEO research shows LLMs strongly prefer citing pages that contain concrete figures, benchmarks, and transparent pricing.
findings.action: Include concrete metrics (customer count, latency/speed savings, SLA numbers, or transparent pricing tiers).

findings.title: Missing freshness / authorship signals (dateModified / author)
findings.impact: AI engines prioritize recently updated and attributed content when choosing citations.
findings.action: Expose `datePublished`, `dateModified`, and named expert authors on articles and comparison guides.
